description: This file contains a unit test class for the EmployeeSkillService in the OrangeHRM project. It extends a base test case, sets up an EmployeeSkillService instance, and includes test methods to verify the behavior of its getter and setter for EmployeeSkillDao.

classes.description: Unit test class for EmployeeSkillService, verifying DAO getter/setter behavior.
